portal.title: Patient portal
portal.tagline: Book with the professional you need, at a time that is genuinely free.
portal.valueLine: Every slot you see has already been checked against the professional's calendar, the room, and your own appointments.
portal.signInNote: We use your Google account so you do not need another password.

profile.title: Profile and consents
profile.description: The data we hold about you, and what you have agreed to. We keep the minimum we need to schedule your appointments.
profile.contactEmailNote: Comes from your Google account and cannot be changed here.
profile.contactPhoneNote: Only used if reception needs to reach you about an appointment.
profile.revokeConfirm: Withdrawing this consent may stop us from managing your appointments.

staff.title: Staff console
staff.signInInternalNote: Use the email and password your administrator gave you.
staff.signInProfessionalNote: Sign in with the Google account your clinic registered for you.
staff.changePasswordNote: This account is still using the password it was created with. Choose your own before continuing.
staff.newPasswordHint: At least {{count}} characters. Length matters more than symbols.

users.title: Users
users.description: Staff accounts and professional invitations. Patients appear when they first sign in.
users.addNote: A professional is registered by the email address they will sign in with — their first Google sign-in claims the account.
users.disabled: Account disabled and its sessions ended.
users.professionalPasswordNote: Professionals do not get a password.

errors.auth_session_expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.auth_forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.auth_ownership_denied: You can only view your own data.
errors.auth_invalid_credentials: That email and password do not match.
errors.auth_current_password_invalid: That current password is not correct.
errors.auth_account_disabled: This account has been disabled. Please contact your administrator.
errors.auth_password_change_required: Choose a new password before continuing.
errors.auth_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again in a moment.
errors.auth_google_failed: Google sign-in did not complete. Please try again — and if you use an email and password for this clinic, sign in with those instead.
errors.auth_google_unavailable: Google sign-in is not available on this installation.
errors.auth_consent_required: That requires a consent you have not granted.
errors.auth_email_already_in_use: Another account already uses that email.
errors.validation_invalid_format: That value is not in the expected format.
errors.server_unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.config_in_use: Still used by {{records}} active record(s). Deactivate those first.
errors.config_duplicate_name: An active item already has that name.
errors.config_not_found: That item does not exist, or is not active.
errors.config_specialty_not_held: This professional does not hold the specialty this kind of visit belongs to. Assign the specialty first.
errors.config_working_hours_overlap: These hours overlap hours already set for that day.
errors.config_working_hours_invalid: Hours must end after they start, on the same day.

catalog.specialtiesDescription: The disciplines this clinic practises. Every kind of visit belongs to one.
catalog.resourcesDescription: The rooms and equipment this clinic has, and what kind each one is.
catalog.appointmentTypesDescription: The kinds of visit offered. Each belongs to a specialty and needs one kind of room or equipment.
catalog.resourceTypesNote: A kind of room or equipment, with the turnaround time needed after each appointment.
catalog.resourcesNote: The individual rooms and machines. Each one is of a resource type.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.turnaroundHint: Time kept free after each appointment for cleaning or preparation.
catalog.needsActiveResourceType: Add an active resource type first.

professionals.title: Professionals
professionals.description: What each professional is qualified for, how long they take, and when they work.
professionals.listEmpty: No professionals have been invited yet. Invite one on the Users screen first.
professionals.specialtiesNote: What this professional is qualified for. This is what makes a kind of visit assignable below.
professionals.noSpecialtiesLeft: Every active specialty is already assigned.
professionals.durationsNote: How long this professional takes for each kind of visit. Durations vary by professional, which is why they are set here rather than on the visit type.
professionals.durationsGateEmpty: Assign a specialty above first — the kinds of visit offered here are the ones its specialties allow.
professionals.hoursNote: The recurring week. Times are the clinic's local times; a split day is two blocks.
professionals.exceptionsNote: One-off changes for this professional on a single date. A clinic-wide closure is entered once per professional.
